_note: Editorial autopilot policy. Governs story CADENCE (stories publish continuously; weekly issues only organise them) and which researched stories may be approved without a human. Read by scripts/editorial_autopilot.py, scripts/ingest_story_package.py and scripts/runway_guard.py. The hourly publisher (scripts/publish_due.py) is unchanged: it still publishes only status=scheduled + approvedAt + due.

autoApproval._note: A story may be approved by autopilot only if it is in an auto-approvable risk class AND meets every sourcing rule. Anything else is ingested as status=held with a heldReason, and never publishes until a human approves it.

autoApprovableRiskClasses.seasonal-observation: Seasonal coastal observations based on authoritative sources.
autoApprovableRiskClasses.practical-guide: Practical local guides based on current first-party information.
autoApprovableRiskClasses.history-explainer: Delaware history explainers sourced to institutional or primary sources.
autoApprovableRiskClasses.field-note: Short Field Notes based wholly on sourced facts.

heldRiskClasses.allegation: Allegations about identifiable people or businesses.
heldRiskClasses.product-endorsement: Product endorsements presented as editorial fact.
heldRiskClasses.uncertain-logistics: Uncertain access, parking, fees or hours.
heldRiskClasses.single-weak-source: Key premise depends on a single weak or unverified source.

forbiddenPatterns._note: Case-insensitive regular expressions. A match in an auto-approval-eligible story's prose rejects the package: these are the shapes invented visits, interviews and quotes take.
forbiddenPatterns.dbf-visit: \b(on our visit|when we were there|our reporter|this reporter|we were there)\b
forbiddenPatterns.interview: \b(told (delaware beach finds|dbf|us)|in an interview|said in an interview|speaking to (us|dbf))\b
